verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents parts of a manual-evidence workflow. Controls have assigned owners responsible for them [55, 39, 49]. Tasks can be assigned from a unified task view [12]. Evidence requests can take attachments, comments and status updates [20], and outstanding requests can be queried [29]. The only documented reminders are for access-review timelines [30], which is an adjacent feature and does not cover manual artifacts generally. missing for 10: per-artifact due dates, renewal reminders for manually uploaded evidence, expiry/staleness tracking on manual artifacts, owner assignment at the evidence-artifact level (not just the control level), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
